QuestInfo.name: [Ren] Home's Where the Heart Is
QuestInfo.0: It's been a while since you were last in Vallora. You should visit Lenna and Lili at the lake.
QuestInfo.1: It's been a while since you were last in Vallora. You should visit Lenna and Lili at the lake.
QuestInfo.2: When you visited Lenna and Lili at the lake, Lenna gave you a letter that had fallen behind the dresser. The letter was from Saya. She wrote it in case she didn't get the chance to say goodbye to you in person. Saya's friendship for you was deeper than this lake and put your heart at peace.
